verification.exact_subcheck_boundary: Finite exact checks do not independently certify universal theorem statements.

limitations: Solver proof candidates and self-checks only; no independent-verifier receipt or Lean proof.
The exact countermodel refutes only a relaxed projection-compression implication. It is not a zeta-zero configuration and does not refute the parent grid theorem or Lamzouri Proposition 2.1.
Analytic all-period claims are justified by README proofs, not by extrapolating finite rational checks.
The rounding lemma assumes the exact target spectrum and preserves it; an actual source projection may need additional rank/trace accounting.
The source cyclic-wrap estimate has not been established. A normalized one-step commutator bound is insufficient.
Local matching is restricted to real positive atoms and assumes their local sinc energy is controlled; no deduction from a global signed off-line defect is made.
Small discarded count does not imply negligible operator error without a proved Bessel bound.
No full repository CI/test suite, bundled inventory/record validator, upstream formal build or isolated verifier was run; direct GitHub DNS failed and package-local checks are reported separately.
No unconditional zero-proportion improvement, RH proof/refutation, or literature-wide novelty claim.
